messages:
maya: heads up — noticed invoice lines for tenant 'acme' spiking yesterday, digging in :eyes:
ashok: I think I saw this — some metering events are missing the variant tag so they end up under 'default' in aggregation
maya: example raw event we pulled from the ingest topic:
```json
{ \"req_id\": \"r-9876\", \"client_id\": \"acme-42\", \"model\": \"redwood-7b\", \"tokens\": 120, \"route\": \"fallback\", \"retry_of\": \"r-9875\" }
```
lucy: if retry_of path rewrites payload it's plausible the variant got dropped during dedupe/transform
sam: yep, dedupe worker does a shallow copy today. it only preserves fields in allowed_fields list — variant wasn't in that list. Oops. /cc @billing-bot
billing-bot: note: ingest schema v2 expects field \"model_variant\". Missing model_variant will be logged as \"variant_unknown\" for downstream aggregation.
ashok: suggested fix: (1) include model_variant in allowed_fields for dedupe copy; (2) when retry_of is present, attempt to fetch original event variant from raw-store and attach it before emit; (3) make aggregation respect model_variant dimension but with a rollup for low-cardinality variants
lucy: big caveat: cardinality explosion on dashboard if we add variant as dimension verbatim. we should have a sampling/rollup rule: variants with <1k tokens/hr go to \"other\" bucket, and allow tenant-level opt-in for full breakout
maya: quick numbers — from a sample tenant it looks like ~0.7% of tokens over the last 48h got variant_unknown, but for two enterprise tenants that was 3-5% which explains invoice deltas
sam: rollout plan idea: canary deploy the dedupe change to attach variant for 24h in shadow mode (emit corrected events to a shadow topic and compute a delta)
nashok: (typo: i'm ashok) +1. also propose backfill script for past 30 days to correct stored invoice lines where model_variant is null. something like:
```sql
-- one-time backfill, mark as corrected to avoid double-charge
UPDATE invoice_lines
SET model_variant = metadata->\'variant\', corrected = true
WHERE model_variant IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '30 days';
```
lucy: backfill risk: double-charge if invoices are regenerated. we should add a corrected flag and ensure billing pipeline ignores lines with corrected=true when reprocessing, or run in a dry-run + reconcile mode first
maya: agreed. also add alerting: fire if variant_unknown rate > 0.1% over 1h across prod ingestion
billing-bot: alert rule created: metering.variant_unknown_rate > 0.001 for 1h -> paging oncall
sam: i'll own canary + shadow aggregation + backfill plan. targeting canary tonight 22:00 UTC. will post a follow-up with results and delta numbers
lucy: i'll add dashboard rollup + sampling rules, and a small widget to show top 10 variants and an \"other\" bucket
ashok: after canary if delta looks good we can flip the dedupe change and run backfill in off-hours. also schedule a postmortem doc and customer outreach if invoices move >1% for any tenant
maya: thanks all. please drop any logs/deltas here. i'll coordinate comms if needed :thumbsup:
billing-bot: scheduled job created: canary-metering-attach-variant-2026-03-21T22:00Z
sam: will post shadow delta outputs in ~6h after canary completes
maya: leaving this thread open for results — remind me to escalate if we see >1% revenue impact
notes: thread about missing model_variant on retried meter events, proposed dedupe changes, canary + backfill plan, dashboard rollup to avoid cardinality explosion, alerting and ownership
